title: Amazon stock soars 15% as e-commerce giant's AWS cloud business booms in 'home run' quarter
excerpt: The e-commerce and cloud giant topped second quarter expectations as accelerating cloud growth at Amazon Web Services (AWS) helped drive strong results.
content_html:
What's happened: Amazon (AMZN) stock soared 15% on Friday.

What's behind the move: The e-commerce and cloud giant topped second quarter expectations as accelerating cloud growth at Amazon Web Services (AWS) helped drive strong results. Amazon also said its AI and custom chip businesses have each surpassed a $25 billion annualized revenue run rate.

AWS generated $42.2 billion in second quarter revenue, up 36.7% year over year, fueled by strength across both its core cloud business and AI services.

"We added over $4.6 billion in revenue quarter over quarter — about 80% more than our largest increase ever. Our backlog stands at $496 billion, growing triple digits year over year," Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said during the company's earnings call.

"Customers choose AWS because we offer the broadest capabilities. They want their AI inference to reside near their other applications and data, and more of it resides in AWS than anywhere else," he added.

Amazon also said its custom chip business is growing at a triple-digit year-over-year rate.

What else you need to know: Heading into the earnings report, Wall Street was closely watching Amazon's cloud growth and capital expenditures on AI infrastructure.

The company said it plans to spend more on AI infrastructure, raising its capital expenditures to approximately $220 billion, up from its prior guidance of around $200 billion.

But Wall Street is willing to overlook the increased spending given AWS's accelerating growth and expanding operating margins.

"This was really a home run for Amazon," said Arun Sundaram, senior vice president at CFRA Research.

CEO Andy Jassy noted that demand for AI and cloud computing continues to outstrip server capacity, with 2027 planned expansion already largely booked into 2028.

"This growth rate justifies the spending," Sundaram said. "AWS is now running at about a $170 billion annual revenue run rate — that's more than four times larger than it was in 2019."

Amazon shares are up 17% year-to-date.

Ines Ferre is a senior business reporter for Yahoo Finance. Follow her on X at @ines_ferre.

content_html_zh:
发生了什么：亚马逊 (AMZN) 股价周五飙升 15%。

此举背后的原因：这家电子商务和云巨头第二季度的业绩超出了预期，亚马逊网络服务 (AWS) 云计算的加速增长帮助推动了强劲的业绩。 亚马逊还表示，其人工智能和定制芯片业务的年化收入均已超过 250 亿美元。

在其核心云业务和人工智能服务的强劲推动下，AWS 第二季度收入达到 422 亿美元，同比增长 36.7%。

“我们的收入季度环比增加超过 46 亿美元，比我们有史以来的最大增幅高出约 80%。 我们的积压订单达到 4960 亿美元，同比增长三位数。”亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 在公司财报电话会议上表示。

“客户选择 AWS 是因为我们提供最广泛的功能。 他们希望他们的人工智能推理能够驻留在其他应用程序和数据附近，而且其中更多的数据驻留在 AWS 中，而不是其他任何地方。”他补充道。

亚马逊还表示，其定制芯片业务正以三位数的同比速度增长。

您还需要了解什么：在发布收益报告之前，华尔街正在密切关注亚马逊的云增长和人工智能基础设施的资本支出。

该公司表示，计划在人工智能基础设施上投入更多资金，将资本支出从之前指导的约 2000 亿美元增加到约 2200 亿美元。

但考虑到 AWS 的加速增长和不断扩大的营业利润，华尔街愿意忽视支出的增加。

CFRA Research 高级副总裁阿伦·桑达拉姆 (Arun Sundaram) 表示：“这对亚马逊来说确实是一次全垒打。”

首席执行官 Andy Jassy 指出，人工智能和云计算的需求继续超过服务器容量，2027 年计划的扩张已大部分预订到 2028 年。

“这种增长率证明了支出的合理性，”桑达拉姆说。 “AWS 目前的年收入运行速度约为 1700 亿美元，是 2019 年的四倍多。”

今年迄今，亚马逊股价已上涨 17%。
